user.title: Room Advisor
user.description:
Room Advisor publishes what is advisable in each room, and why. It never performs the action itself.

This hub holds your house-wide settings: the shared outdoor sensors and the default thresholds that every room inherits. Add your rooms, and choose those shared inputs, after setup.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Already configured. There is one Room Advisor hub per house; add each room to the existing hub.
